verdict.rationale: Cekura is a SaaS platform that ingests and stores customer call transcripts and recordings, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out, no data-use policy, and no no-training guarantee. PII redaction is an adjacent privacy control, not a way to stop data being used for model training, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
